spec: solar-verify's Counter spec (crates/verify/examples/Counter.sol NatSpec, SolidCore.Refinement.Solar.VerifyCounter.spec), proved of stage0 by holds_stage0
excluded: source: solar's first lowered MIR (stage0) under the oracle with EthLib's caller, Keccak-256 and environment, not SolidCore: no SolidCore stage reaches loops yet (frontend trust boundary at the first lowered MIR)
allowed statuses: every status (the spec states success conditions; Outcome of specPost carries what the spec says of reverts)
deployment: the init code is not covered
calls: one frame, caller 0x2000, contract at 0x1000, the block and transaction of Target.message

valid calls: every call whose selector is bump(uint256) with argument word n < 2^32 (any further call data, any value, any storage); Contracts.VerifyCounter.Shape.functional states equivalence, termination and the spec for every n; the other functions of the contract are outside this statement

resources: gas bound Bump.gasBound call = gasBoundL cert ((n + 2) * 22), linear in n, from the final EVM IR's block bound (the MIR rank carried along the bounded stage simulations, termination's EvmBound.evm11_ends_within) and the loop checker run forward; coarse (22100 gas per item)
vacuity: Allowed is True (every status); the postcondition is the Lean restatement SolidCore.Refinement.Solar.VerifyCounter.spec, and the exported VC of Counter.bump is refused
